note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (four-party Federal Council), not measured data. Influence reflects a strong business and banking sector, influential farmers' organisations, unions with a smaller role than in neighbouring countries, a militia army with conscription, and direct democracy that gives organised groups leverage through referendums.

interest_groups.note: Business, banking and export industry associations.
Church-state relations are set by the cantons.
Linguistic communities are represented institutionally; this covers immigrant communities.
